The '''Bitter Reaches''' is the name given to the northeastern region of [[Azshara]]. It is densely populated by [[hippogryph]]s, [[ooze]]s and [[chimaerae]], except along the northern edge where elite [[mountain giant]]s have displaced most of the wildlife.  Some [[herb]]s such as [[Mountain Silversage]] grow here, though sparsely.
